rejectionReasons.product: Wrong category selected — office chairs must map to HSN 9401 under Office Furniture.
rejectionReasons.hsn: HSN mismatch is the #1 catalogue rejection. Chairs need 9401, not 9403 (tables).
rejectionReasons.parameters: Missing golden parameters (material, gas lift class, wheel type) cause technical rejection.
rejectionReasons.images: GeM requires 3+ images at 800×800px on white background. Lifestyle shots are rejected.
rejectionReasons.pricing: Price far below market triggers quality suspicion; too high loses L1 ranking.

rejectionReasons.product: Ergonomic chairs need explicit adjustability specs — generic 'office chair' category fails.
rejectionReasons.hsn: Use HSN 9401 for seating. Do not file under medical furniture codes.
rejectionReasons.parameters: Ergonomic certification and tilt mechanism fields are mandatory for this sub-category.
rejectionReasons.images: Show adjustment features clearly. Blurry or dark images fail automated QC.
rejectionReasons.pricing: Ergonomic chairs below ₹3,000 are often flagged as non-compliant with IS specs.

rejectionReasons.product: Revolving chairs must specify swivel mechanism and gas lift class.
rejectionReasons.hsn: HSN 9401 required. Sellers often wrongly select 940179 (other seating).
rejectionReasons.parameters: Backrest type and warranty period are checked against bid golden parameters.
rejectionReasons.images: White background mandatory. Watermarks or logos on images cause rejection.
rejectionReasons.pricing: Government comparables for Rajasthan cluster around ₹3,850–₹4,250/unit.

rejectionReasons.product: Desks must be under Tables › Office Desks — not computer table category.
rejectionReasons.hsn: Tables use HSN 9403. Using 9401 (chairs) is an automatic rejection.
rejectionReasons.parameters: Dimensions must match IS/market standard format (L×W×H in mm).
rejectionReasons.images: Minimum 3 angles: front, side, laminate close-up on white background.
rejectionReasons.pricing: UP Secretariat comparables show ₹4,100–₹4,350 for similar desks.

rejectionReasons.product: Computer tables need keyboard tray and CPU compartment in golden parameters.
rejectionReasons.hsn: HSN 94036000 for tables. BIS may not apply but specs still mandatory.
rejectionReasons.parameters: Cable management and tray fields are validated for school/education bids.
rejectionReasons.images: Show tray and compartment open. Single hero image submissions fail 33% of reviews.
rejectionReasons.pricing: Rajasthan school supply awards cluster at ₹4,520–₹4,650/unit.

rejectionReasons.product: Visitor/waiting chairs are a separate sub-category from revolving office chairs.
rejectionReasons.hsn: Use 94017900 for other seating. Do not reuse revolving chair HSN mapping.
rejectionReasons.parameters: Stackability and UV finish matter for outdoor/semi-outdoor government sites.
rejectionReasons.images: Stacked view photo recommended. Minimum resolution 800×800px.
rejectionReasons.pricing: Visitor chairs priced like executive chairs trigger manual review.
